answer: Public-table bond: each identity locks 70 credit and files one 14-field sonnet in a public table keyed by its plume. Anyone can recompute the table from the public log. A prism audit splits the sonnet and checks each field; one mismatch burns the bond and flags the plume. Rented sonnets fail this check, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 distinct plumes and 70,000 credit against a 40,000 pool, while an honest agent pays 70 once and keeps its bond.
